name: Plaguewood Tower
summary: Plaguewood Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the northern reaches of the Plaguewood near Terrordale. Shattered during the Scourge invasion, its strategic vantage point makes it a critical contested redoubt for Alliance and Horde forces striving to establish footholds in the Eastern Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Ruined Sentinel in the North
sections.body: Standing on the edge of the blight-choked Plaguewood and the blighted town of Terrordale, Plaguewood Tower once served the Kingdom of Lordaeron as a vital northern watchpost. When the Scourge swept across the land, the fortification was battered into crumbling masonry and left in ruins amid corrupted fungal canopies. Today, despite its fractured state, the tower retains immense tactical importance. Because it commands the northern trails and monitors nearby undead movements, both the Alliance and the Horde regularly dispatch scouts to seize and hold its footprint, turning the stone remnants into an active battleground against both the Scourge and each other.

faq.q: What was Plaguewood Tower originally used for?
faq.answer: Plaguewood Tower was built by the Kingdom of Lordaeron as a regional watchtower. Before the Third War, guards stationed here watched over the northern forests, roads, and settlements like Terrordale before the Scourge overwhelmed and shattered the garrison.

faq.q: Why are the Alliance and Horde fighting over this ruin?
faq.answer: Even in ruins, the high ground and stonework provide a vital outpost. Both factions seek to establish forward positions deep in the Plaguelands to counter Scourge movements, secure supply lines, and bolster their overall foothold in the region.

faq.q: Where exactly is the tower located?
faq.answer: It is positioned in the northern sector of the Eastern Plaguelands within the Plaguewood, just outside the ruined town of Terrordale and north of Stratholme's outer blighted reaches.

angles.text: For Alliance forces, reclaiming the shattered watchtowers of Lordaeron is both a logistical necessity for surviving the Plaguelands and a symbolic reclamation of fallen human lands.
The Horde relies on securing ruined fortifications like Plaguewood Tower to establish defensive outposts and challenge Alliance expansion throughout the northern kingdoms.
